scripts.lint: pnpm check && node script/lint.ts && pnpm lint:boundaries
scripts.test: pnpm test:script && node script/heavy.ts pnpm --recursive --if-present test
scripts.typecheck: node script/heavy.ts sh -c 'pnpm typecheck:root && pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck'
scripts.typecheck:compat: node script/heavy.ts sh -c 'pnpm typecheck:compat:root && pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck:compat'
scripts.ready: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm typecheck:compat && pnpm test && pnpm test:package
